content_of_post_to_comment:
Rating today 6/10

Officially crossed day 1. Honestly it was really hard at uni to not have reels on my phone, but eventually I got used to it. I also finally managed to read (psycho cybernetics) a little. Spent time learning how to get a remote desktop setup for my use case (parsec + tailscale). It was fun finally learning something. Now I'll be able to remote into my pc from anywhere to play games at high graphics (and run vibe for transcribing). managed to get a little bit of math homework done too.

I did spend too much time (about 2h) on YouTube once I got on my PC though, since I don't have any extensions to block websites.

Goals for tomorrow are:

- finish remaining math assignments

- clean room, washroom, and mow grass

- socialize more at uni

- get 9k more geo in HK lmao
comment: Getting through day 1 without reels is honestly a bigger win than it sounds. The first few days are usually the hardest because your brain keeps looking for that quick dopamine hit. Also, the Parsec + Tailscale setup is a pretty cool example of replacing passive scrolling with actually learning something useful. The YouTube rabbit hole after getting on your PC might be the next thing to experiment with though, since your environment seems to be the main trigger.
